# m3

> Material Design 3 components for React, built on shadcn/ui (Base UI) and Tailwind CSS v4, with an application boilerplate. Every color, radius, font and motion value comes from one CSS file (src/theme.css), so the whole look changes by replacing that file.

Assistants: read AGENTS.md first (key rules, commands, where things live), then docs/conventions.md before changing code and docs/theming.md before creating or editing a theme. Validate themes with `npm run check:theme`.

## Docs

- [Live gallery](https://m3.khojlabs.com/gallery): every component in all variants and states, plus the boilerplate's page components and utilities
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/khoj-labs/m3/blob/main/AGENTS.md): key rules, commands and repo map for AI assistants
- [Conventions](https://github.com/khoj-labs/m3/blob/main/docs/conventions.md): component and boilerplate rules, code style, tooling gotchas, common tasks
- [Theming spec](https://github.com/khoj-labs/m3/blob/main/docs/theming.md): variable reference, color role recipe, how to create a theme, validation
- [README](https://github.com/khoj-labs/m3/blob/main/README.md): overview, how to override the theme and the boilerplate, credits, license

## Source

- [src/theme.css](https://github.com/khoj-labs/m3/blob/main/src/theme.css): the active theme (all colors, radii, fonts, motion, elevation, layout)
- [src/themes](https://github.com/khoj-labs/m3/tree/main/src/themes): alternative themes (violet, ocean)
- [src/index.css](https://github.com/khoj-labs/m3/blob/main/src/index.css): maps theme variables to Tailwind utilities
- [src/components/ui](https://github.com/khoj-labs/m3/tree/main/src/components/ui): all components (shadcn-generated and 11 hand-built)
- [src/boilerplate](https://github.com/khoj-labs/m3/tree/main/src/boilerplate): app shell, page header, list page, error boundary, route guard, logger, analytics, http client, cache, error codes
- [src/gallery](https://github.com/khoj-labs/m3/tree/main/src/gallery): every component in all variants and states (route /gallery)
- [scripts/check-theme.mjs](https://github.com/khoj-labs/m3/blob/main/scripts/check-theme.mjs): theme validator (variables, light and dark, WCAG contrast)
